newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Speed buys most Martinair bellyspace to N. America.
newsitem.headline: Speed buys most Martinair bellyspace to N. America.

text.p: Most of Martinair's belly-hold capacity to North America has been bought by Speed Handling Services.
Destinations the Schiphol-based wholesaler will sell from the Netherlands include San Francisco, Los Angeles and Toronto, Dan de Wit, Speed managing director, told Reuters.
Speed will begin to sell the belly-hold capacity to these destinations on an exclusive basis from April 7.
Martinair serves these destinations twice weekly, with the exception of Los Angeles which is three times weekly.

Toronto is operated with a Boeing 767, while the other two destinations are operated with an McDonnell Douglas MD-11. Around 12 to 13 tonnes per flight will be available on the flights during the summer season which operates from April until October.
This enables Martinair to concentrate on selling its freighter space, said De Wit.
"Exports from Europe to the U.S. are very strong. A lot of our clients will have dedicated allotments on the flights so they have guaranteed space," he said.
Much of the cargo to North America is perishable traffic including peppers, tomatoes and flowers, he said.
Martinair will still sell its own Florida belly-hold capacity.

In a separate deal, Wisbeen, a leading perishables and flower company, will sell Martinair's bellyhold capacity to New York. This Netherlands-Newark service will be a twice-weekly service, operated with a B767, with a capacity of around 25 tonnes a week.
